svg.aria-label: The hand-off: Chat A’s last recap is saved as a note, Chat B reads it and takes the work over, Chat A is then told to stop, and a 100% claim is checked against git.
svg.text: A note carries the work from one chat to the next, the same in Claude Code, Codex CLI and Grok Build.
Stop saves it as A’s note.
A’s note is listed for B to
GUARANTEES, COMMANDS AND WHAT IT NEVER DOES
The next chat can act on the note. The old chat is told to stop: its tool calls are
denied, except those that stop work. A 100% claim is checked against git before
takeover marks the old chat; resume-here lifts the mark, and on Grok marks
the newer chat in turn. list prints the bars; notes shows the menu. Notes are
plain JSON, kept 72 hours, this machine only.
No network, no telemetry, no dependencies. It never edits your code and reads
git only, and every mode exits 0, so a broken hook can never block the tool itself.
ai-session-handoff · one script, three tools · github.com/southlodge/ai-session-handoff
